The honey in this mushroom dish gives it a sweet, complex taste and a savory finish|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Glazed Mushrooms are meals made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]] together with [[Courser Bee Honey]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can only be made by using a Mushroom that has a differing effect to the Courser Bee Honey. Eating this meal will heal a few [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. The Courser Bee Honey gives the Mushrooms a sweet and complex taste with a savory finish. Only one variation of Glazed Mushrooms exists: * '''Energizing Glazed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Glazed Mushrooms}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The honey in this mushroom dish gives it a sweet, complex taste and a savory finish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using either [[Hylian Shroom]]s or [[Stamella Shroom]]s. If eaten, they will replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Glazed Mushrooms is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[The Yiga Clan Attacks!]]". It is made using two [[Stamella Shroom]]s and one [[Courser Bee Honey]]. Through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]", the number of Stamella Shrooms required can be lowered to one. Preparing Glazed Mushrooms before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] will increase the [[Warrior]]'s movement speed by ten percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Glazed Mushrooms Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Glazed Mushrooms ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Glazed Meat * Glazed Seafood * Glazed Veggies * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
